page_title: GET 1-0 OSA | Getafe v Osasuna 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Quintero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the top left corner, but David Soria is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
90+2' Although Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) is just on the bench, Alejandro Quintero has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee is firm and issues Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) a deserved yellow card.
89' Problems for Jose Bordalas Jimenez as Mario Martin (Getafe) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Davinchi replaces him.

89' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Raul Garcia (Osasuna), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.

86' Asier Osambela (Osasuna) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by David Soria. This effort really didn't trouble him.
83' It looks like Asier Osambela (Osasuna) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
82' It is time for a substitution. Damian Caceres (Getafe) is on for Adrian Liso.
82' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Aimar Oroz and he is replaced by Raul Moro (Osasuna).
81' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
81' Substitution. Jon Moncayola did his best and is replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
80' The attendance for today's match is 8566.

78' What a chance that is! Domingos Duarte (Getafe) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
77' Getafe have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Ruben Garcia has picked up an injury and is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
68' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kike Barja (Osasuna) replacing Lucas Torro.
68' It's time for a substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) comes on in place of Jorge Herrando.
66' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
63' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
61' 5:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
59' 1 - 0 Goal! Luis Vazquez passes the ball to Luis Milla (Getafe) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Sergio Herrera couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
57' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
56' Mario Martin (Getafe) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
54' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Getafe have a corner.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
49' Javi Galan (Osasuna) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Zaid Romero (Getafe) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Osasuna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
40' Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mario Martin (Getafe).

38' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
38' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
38' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
36' The ratio of the ball possession is 60:40.
34' Luis Milla (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
31' A cooling break is underway.
30' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
25' Luis Milla (Getafe) fires the resulting free kick towards the roof of the net from the edge of the box, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a superb save to deny him.
24' Foul! Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Getafe win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation. Getafe have a free kick.

18' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the left side of the target fails to beat David Soria, who makes a sensational save.
17' Osasuna are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
13' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by David Soria.

7' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Dangerous play by Abdel Abqar (Getafe). Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Osasuna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
2' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
2' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
2' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero was nominated as the referee for this game.
